{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats are wholly committed to supporting a public U.S. Postal Service.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight all efforts to privatize the U.S. Postal Service.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work to ensure the U.S. Postal Service is financially sustainable, including by repealing the mandate that the agency \"pre-fund\" retiree health costs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will protect the Postal Service's universal service obligation as a core American value.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will maintain six-day and doorstep mail delivery.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Six-day and doorstep mail delivery is a lifeline for rural Americans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work to restore service to appropriate levels, including overnight delivery of first-class mail and periodicals within the same metropolitan area.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will appoint members to the Board of Governors and the Postal Regulatory Commission who champion a strong public Postal Service.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support new revenue streams for the U.S. Postal Service, including allowing secure shipping of alcoholic beverages by mail.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will explore options to enable unbanked and underbanked Americans to access financial services through the Postal Service.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Trump Administration has repudiated the idea that out of many, the United States is one.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Trump Administration has abandoned values as a diverse, compassionate, and welcoming country.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Trump Administration has pursued an approach to immigration that does not strengthen the United States.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Trump Administration's immigration policies have made communities less safe.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Trump Administration's immigration policies have undermined the economy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Trump Administration's immigration policies have tarnished the United States' image around the world.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Trump Administration forcibly separated families and put children in cages.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Trump Administration deported veterans who have fought to defend the United States' freedoms.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Trump Administration conducted militarized raids on workplaces.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Trump Administration endangered lives by denying COVID-19 testing and treatment based on immigration status, including to essential workers at the forefront of the pandemic response.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Trump Administration banned people from traveling to the United States based on their faith or their country of origin.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Trump Administration turned away refugees and asylum seekers fleeing violence and persecution.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The actions of the Trump Administration should not happen in the United States again.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
